title: Deal Desk Analyst
description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

Location:  Remote (US) - Mountain or Pacific Time

Reports to: Deal Desk Manager 

About the Team:
The Revenue Operations team at AlphaSense drives productivity and improves efficiency for our account executives, account managers and sales development reps. We create and implement operational reporting & analytics, improve processes, and enable strategic initiatives that impact the revenue organization.  At our core, we are a dynamic team of highly driven self-starters who are passionate about operations and thrive in a fast paced, challenging environment.

About the Role:
We're looking for an Analyst to join our Deal Desk team as we scale. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Finance, and Legal - helping structure, price, resolve redlines and close deals quickly while setting the foundation for repeatable, auditable processes. You'll combine hands-on deal support with process design and a growing use of AI tooling to speed up cycle times, and you'll help define the metrics that show how well the team and our deals are performing.

Who you are:

• 2+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, FP&A, or a related revenue operations function, ideally at a high-growth SaaS or tech company.

• Strong grasp of deal structuring, pricing, and contract fundamentals (discounting, ramps, multi-year terms, non-standard clauses).

• Hands-on experience with CRM (Salesforce). Quoting and/or CLM tools experience is a plus.

• Curiosity for applying AI tools to operational or deal workflows.

• Excellent judgment under time pressure 

• Strong cross-functional communicator, comfortable working with Sales, Legal, and Finance.

• Process-oriented mindset with a bias toward documenting and scaling what works.

What You’ll Do

• Proactively review inbound deals for structure, pricing, discounting, and terms before they reach approval - flagging risk and inconsistency early rather than after the fact.

• Serve as a hands-on partner to Sales throughout the deal cycle, answering questions about deal commercials in real time and unblocking deals stuck in review.

• Apply pricing guardrails and discount frameworks consistently, and escalate exceptions through the appropriate approval path.

• Partner with Legal and Finance to ensure non-standard terms are reviewed, priced, and documented correctly.

• Identify bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement in the deal review process - from approval routing to documentation to handoffs between teams.

• Work with RevOps/Systems teams to embed AI-assisted steps directly into the Deal Desk workflow (CPQ, CLM, CRM).

• Maintain the core Deal Desk metrics: cycle time, approval turnaround, discount/exception rates, deal desk SLA attainment, and deal quality.

title: Staff Systems Engineer, EW
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to join our Electronic Warfare (EW) team supporting various Electronic Support Measures (ESM) and Electronic Attack (EA) / Electronic Counter Measures (ECM) Systems. This is an exciting role which provides an opportunity to work across the full product life cycle, from concept to deployment.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 15+ years of hands on systems engineering leadership experience

• Experience with system design, development and test of ESM and EA / ECM in one or more of the following ground-based or aerial EW domains:

• Counter-Radar

• Counter-UAS

• Counter-Comms (Wireless protocols: Bluetooth, 3G/4G/5G, Wi-Fi, etc)

• Counter-PNT

• Counter-RCIED

• Experience with embedded devices and Software Defined Radios (SDRs).

• Experience with system requirements creation, requirement traceability, and requirement verification and validation.

• Experience coordinating across disciplines to ensure system requirements and design are properly and thoroughly defined, implemented, and validated.

• Experience leading program teams through systems engineering reviews and owning related CDRLs including System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), and Critical Design Review (CDR).

• Excellent technical writing skill with experience in writing white papers, proposals, trade studies, test plans, test procedures, and test reports.

• Skilled at explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Excellent at balancing multiple projects at any given time.

• Enthusiastic about both working with a team and executing work individually.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret/Top Secret security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience in SIL (System in Lab) design, setup and automation.

• Familiarity with RF systems and RF test equipment including multimeters, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and vector network analyzers.

• Experience with system level RF cascade analysis, co-site analysis, and mission modeling.

• Experience with mission modeling tools like AFSIM and STK.

• Flight Test experience and flight test data analysis.

• Experience in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), including the use of modelling tools (e.g. Cameo)

• Experience in integrating Firmware and Software builds on prototype and production grade hardware.

BENEFITS 

• Platinum Benefits: We offer top tier platinum coverage (medical, dental, vision, life) and cover 100 percent of the premiums for you.

• 16 Weeks paid parental leave for all caregivers.

• Family planning: We’re proud to offer comprehensive family planning support. Fertility planning and treatment, adoption support, gestational carrier support and fertility preservation are all included.

• Unlimited Provisions: From breakfast to dinner, our kitchen team has you covered with healthy meals and snacks at every office.

• Commuter benefits depending on region.

• Relocation assistance.

• Unlimited and Incentivized Time Off.

US Salary Range
$191,000 — $253,000 USD

The team works on turning photos, video, and spatial signals into structured representations that power customer-facing products used by millions of shoppers. title: Sr. Digital Experience Specialist
description:
GoodRx is the leading prescription savings platform in the U.S. Trusted by more than 25 million consumers and 750,000 healthcare professionals annually, GoodRx provides access to savings and affordability options for generic and brand-name medications at more than 70,000 pharmacies nationwide, as well as comprehensive healthcare research and information. Since 2011, GoodRx has helped consumers save nearly $75 billion on the cost of their prescriptions.
Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans.
About the Role:
We are seeking a strategic, detail-oriented Sr. Digital Experience Specialist to enhance digital journeys for GoodRx ’s priority growth areas, including Companion, Weight Loss Subscriptions, and other key business lines. In this role, you will translate business goals, customer insights, and performance data into actionable conversion rate optimization (CRO) and digital experience roadmap, You will work independently and partner across Marketing, Product, Design, Analytics, Engineering, SEO, CRM, and Legal to deliver effective digital experiences and measurable results..

Role & Responsibilities:

• Strategy & Roadmap: Define digital experience strategies for assigned business lines and manage a prioritized CRO and landing-page roadmap.

• Optimization: Drive continuous optimization for landing pages and merchandising modules while ensuring messaging continuity across all channels.

• Experimentation & Analytics: Design, launch, and analyze A/B and multivariate experiments (e.g., using Optimizely) and utilize analytics (e.g., Amplitude, Lookr) to generate actionable insights.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the point of contact for CRO, landing page, and upsell development within Marketing. Partner closely with Marketing and Product leads to ensure testing plans and designs meet evolving business objectives and product/campaign needs.

• AI Integration: Implement repeatable AI-enabled workflows for research, content creation, and process improvement while upholding legal and brand standards. Communicate findings, recommendations, and results to cross-functional stakeholders and adapt approaches based on business needs and performance data.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Business, Design, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience in digital experience, growth marketing, or related digital disciplines.

• Proven ability to lead digital strategy and landing-page optimization across multiple channels.

• Strong understanding of performance marketing and user-centered design.

• Hands-on experience with experimentation platforms (e.g., Optimizely) and analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude, Google Analytics, Looker).

• Proficiency with enterprise CMS (e.g., Contentful) and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Airtable).

• Excellent analytical, project management, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in subscription, healthcare, or high-volume consumer digital businesses.

• Demonstrated ability to build repeatable experimentation, reporting, or AI-enabled workflows that improve team speed and quality.

• Experience partnering with senior stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Design, Analytics, and Engineering.

Measures of Success:

• Successful connection of digital experience priorities to measurable business outcomes.

• Improvement in conversion, engagement, subscriber growth, and retention KPIs.

• Predictable delivery of high-quality experiments and launches.

• Strong cross-functional alignment and reduced operational friction.

title: Vice President, Executive Planning Consultant - Southeast Market
description:
Job Description:
Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.
The Role
The Executive Planning Consultant (EPC) serves as a trusted financial advisor to senior executives and C-suite leaders within key Workplace benefit plan clients. Acting as the primary relationship manager for a select group of executives, the Executive Planning Consultant provides personalized financial planning, retirement income strategies, investment guidance, and asset management support tailored to each client’s unique goals. By integrating workplace benefits and plan provisions into comprehensive financial plans, the EPC helps executives make informed decisions that support both their immediate and long-term financial well-being while delivering outstanding client experience through ongoing consultation and relationship management.
Working as part of a collaborative team that includes managing directors, relationship managers, and executive services associates, the Executive Planning Consultant drives client engagement, business growth, and client satisfaction. This role involves presenting executive services offerings during business reviews, cultivating new opportunities through referrals, seminars, and local events, and identifying strategies to increase assets under management and expand client relationships.
The Expertise and Skills You Bring

• Series 7 and Series 66 licenses required

• Ability to obtain an insurance license within six months of hire

• Bachelor's degree required

• Certified Financial Planner (CFP®) designation preferred

• Completion of CEP Level 1 certification within the first 12 months of employment is strongly encouraged

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in face-to-face investment sales and financial planning

• Proven track record of sales success within the financial services industry

• Experience working with senior executives and employee benefit plans

• Demonstrated success developing new business and managing relationships with high-net-worth clients

• Strong ability to assess clients' unique financial needs and recommend tailored investment and planning solutions

• Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%

• Comprehensive knowledge of brokerage services, insurance products, investment management, estate planning, financial planning, and retirement planning

• Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

• Strategic thinker with the ability to influence and advise executive-level decision-makers

• Outstanding presentation and facilitation skills in both one-on-one and group settings

• Strong territory management capabilities with the ability to prioritize and execute multiple initiatives simultaneously

The Team
The Executive Planning Consultant provides planning and guidance for Fidelity’s Workplace Investing executive clients and operates within Fidelity’s Personal Investing business unit. We are a leading provider of investment management, retirement planning, family conversations, portfolio guidance, brokerage, benefits outsourcing, and many other financial products and services. We believe in establishing relationships, not just in building sales or building our assets. After all, our clients will place their investments, their savings, and their futures in your hands. You’ll be the one who will personally work with them to help achieve their dreams- whether that’s saving for college, for retirement, for a big vacation, or anything else. This is a serious responsibility and that’s why we’ll surround you with amazing, supportive people and all the tools you need.
Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model
Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

title: Software Engineer, Data Platform (Foundations Lead)
description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Data Foundations team builds and operates the batch and streaming infrastructure behind our product features, analytics, search, and AI experiences. We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader to shape the next generation of this platform as Notion serves larger customers, expands globally, and supports more data-intensive products. You’ll identify the highest-leverage problems, set direction, build and develop a high-performing team, and lead multi-quarter initiatives across our data lake, streaming, distributed-compute, governance, and reliability systems. You’ll stay close to critical technical decisions while creating clear ownership, growing engineers and technical leaders, and helping the team execute as one-partnering closely with Data Engineering, Data Product, Search, AI, Infrastructure, and Security.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

- Set the direction for Data Foundations. Turn ambiguous company and customer needs into a clear multi-quarter strategy across the data lake, streaming, distributed compute, governance, and platform reliability-and align engineers and partner teams around it.

- Build and develop a high-performing team. Attract strong engineers, set clear expectations, grow technical leaders, and create an environment of ownership, direct feedback, and accountability.

- Lead the team’s hardest initiatives from idea to operation. Ensure complex work has strong technical ownership, de-risk architectures through prototypes, break work into shippable milestones, and coordinate execution across engineers and teams.

- Make Notion’s data platform enterprise-ready. Guide the team toward durable foundations for external key management, data residency, access controls, lifecycle management, and governance without creating separate systems for every requirement.

- Raise reliability, simplicity, and cost efficiency. Identify systemic risks and architectural gaps, establish clear service ownership, and lead migrations that make Kafka, Debezium, S3/Iceberg, Spark, EMR, Athena, and related systems easier to operate at scale.

- Multiply the engineering organization. Establish reusable abstractions and paved paths, delegate meaningful ownership, raise the quality of technical decisions, and scale expertise through coaching, documentation, tooling, design reviews, and direct collaboration.

SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

- Deep data-platform expertise. You have designed and operated large-scale batch and streaming systems and can reason across storage, compute, ingestion, orchestration, serving, governance, and production operations.

- Direction-setting leadership. You have led a Data Platform or infrastructure team through multi-quarter work-finding the right problems, defining a strategy, sequencing execution, and driving decisions

title: Business Development
description:
WHO WE ARE

Roboflow is building the visual cortex for AGI.

 

Every day, millions of developers and half of the Fortune 100 use Roboflow to count cells https://blog.roboflow.com/cancer-research-computer-vision/ to accelerate cancer research, improve construction site safety https://blog.roboflow.com/preventing-accidents-on-construction-sites-with-computer-vision/, digitize floor plans https://blog.roboflow.com/floor-plan-analysis-computer-vision/, preserve coral reef populations https://blog.roboflow.com/reefos-supercharging-coral-reef-restoration-with-ai/, guide drone flight https://blog.roboflow.com/georeferencing-drone-videos/, and much more https://roboflow.com/templates.

 

We have built the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. We're supported by great customers and investors, having raised over $100 million from Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, Y Combinator, and more.

 

Roboflow Labs is our applied research unit. We train our own open models (RF-DETR). We build our own benchmarks grounded in real enterprise use cases (RF100-VL). And we partner with frontier labs to deliver the training data they need to advance the capabilities that drive the most value back to our customers.

 

Behind all of it is a global network of millions of Roboflow developers who have annotated billions of images and videos to date, as well as a proven enterprise business that is exploding as AI traverses the physical economy.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As the Business Development lead at Roboflow Labs, you'll build our relationships with the frontier labs. Our stakeholders are research scientists, human-data teams, and technical executives. You'll build and run the motion that targets across all three.

- Build and own the pipeline of frontier lab accounts.

- Run the full cycle: sourcing and outreach, discovery with researchers and data-partnerships teams, sample packets and evaluations, pricing and proposals, negotiation with procurement and legal, and close.

- Stand up the systems for a repeatable motion: CRM, pipeline reviews, forecasting, and the account plans that turn a first purchase into a durable relationship

- Represent Labs at industry events and online.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a technical seller ready to hit the pavement in the heart of the AI boom. You have high agency and a bias toward action.

- Sufficiently fluent enough in frontier models to hold a credible discovery conversation with a researcher.

- Skilled at multi-threaded deals: research champions, budget owners, procurement, legal, and executives, sometimes all in one account

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Nice to have: an existing network at frontier labs, familiarity with computer vision or robotics, prior sales experience, a track record of owning and beating a number

 

WHERE YOU'LL WORK

Roboflow is a fully distributed company with hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Singapore, and Brazil. Roboflow Labs works in person in San Francisco. We host full company retreats twice per year.

 

WHAT YOU'LL RECEIVE

The target compensation for this role is $80,000 - $160,000 base salary commensurate with experience as well as equity in the company. Total cash comp is expected to scale significantly with growth of Roboflow Labs.

In addition, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

- Generous stipends covering travel, productivity, tools, meals, and office.

- Up to 100% of your health insurance costs covered.

- Unlimited PTO - with an annual 2 week minimum.

- 12 weeks parental leave

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Air & Missile Defense Radar team develops cutting-edge tracking algorithms and software systems that detect, track, and characterize airborne threats in real-time. Working in small, focused teams, our software engineers design and implement sophisticated tracking solutions that protect lives and critical assets. Our work spans the full spectrum-from developing novel multi-target tracking algorithms to building high-performance distributed systems that process massive amounts of sensor data in milliseconds

We don't just publish papers; we deploy production-grade systems that our government and industry customers depend on for mission-critical operations. If you're passionate about applying mathematics, software engineering, and signal processing to solve complex real-world problems, we want to hear from you.

• Design and implement advanced tracking algorithms for novel air and missile threats, including multi-target tracking, track fusion, and discrimination techniques

• Build and leverage modeling & simulation environments to validate tracking performance, quantify system capabilities, and identify areas for improvement

• Optimize tracking software for performance-critical environments where milliseconds matter

• Communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to cross-functional teams, program leadership, and customers to drive informed decisions

• Participate in customer demonstrations and field tests to ensure successful deployment and operational effectiveness

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8 years of relevant experience & Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or related technical field (or equivalent experience)

• Strong programming skills in C++ and Python

• Solid foundation in mathematics: linear algebra, probability, statistics, and/or differential equations

• Understanding of software engineering fundamentals: design patterns, testing, version control, and debugging

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret SCI security clearance

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with tracking, estimation, or filtering algorithms (Kalman filters, particle filters, multiple hypothesis tracking, etc.)

• Background in controls, estimation theory, or digital signal processing

• Familiarity with radar systems or sensor fusion

• Experience with high-performance computing (multithreading, GPU acceleration, distributed systems)

• Knowledge of machine learning techniques for classification, clustering, or data association

• Proficiency with database technologies (SQL, NoSQL, time-series databases)

• Experience with web development technologies (JavaScript, React, Node.js) for building visualization and analysis tools

• Familiarity with modeling and simulation tools (MATLAB, Simulink, or custom frameworks)

• Experience working in agile development environments

• Active U.S. Top Secret SCI clearance

title: Lead Support Engineer
locationText: Los Angeles, United States; San Francisco, United States
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Role Summary and Impact

This role is within WPP Media, where you will be instrumental in owning production stability, observability, and system health for a mission-critical global campaign governance and compliance platform. As Lead Support Engineer, you will provide advanced L2+ and L3-oriented support for a system running natively on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will investigate complex production issues, implement minor code-level fixes in Python, lead root cause analysis, and improve the reliability of distributed systems. Working closely with the EMEA-based Engineering Tech Lead, Product Owner, and Quality Assurance partners, you will connect production insights with technical roadmap priorities.

The opportunity combines hands-on Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) with technical squad leadership. A foundational monitoring and alerting setup is already in place, giving you the platform to evaluate the current approach, define a clear observability direction, and strengthen system health monitoring across the environment. You will automate runbooks, reduce manual operational effort, and help shape the future support squad for a dedicated product used across global advertising campaigns.

Key Responsibilities

• Own production stability, system health, and observability for a mission-critical campaign governance and compliance platform running on GCP.

• Diagnose and resolve complex, intermittent, and high-priority incidents across application, database, infrastructure, and networking layers.

• Read, debug, and implement minor fixes and patches directly within the existing Python production codebase.

• Define and advance the observability strategy using GCP Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Error Reporting, Prometheus, PromQL, and suitable service level indicators and objectives.

• Lead incident response, post-incident reviews, and end-to-end root cause analysis, partnering with the EMEA Engineering team on permanent remediation.

• Monitor execution flows, performance, data refreshes, automated checks, and recurring compliance reporting to ensure reliable system operation.

• Identify opportunities to automate manual support activity, develop and maintain runbooks, and reduce operational toil.

• Provide technical leadership to the L2+ support squad through coaching, knowledge sharing, prioritization, and effective handovers.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, and Quality Assurance teams to assess operational risk, improve release and change management, and influence technical roadmap decisions.

Skills and Experience

• Advanced education in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• Strong, current Python proficiency, including the ability to read, debug, and implement fixes directly within a shared production codebase.

• Deep, hands-on experience supporting enterprise systems on Google Cloud Platform, including Compute Engine, Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Firestore, Cloud Functions, Identity and Access Management, and virtual private cloud networking.

title: Jr. FP&A Analyst
description:
Wanna join the adventure?
Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours.
The AI Engineering team is where models meet the spacecraft. We own the full path from a partner's trained model to something that actually runs - fast - on flight hardware: compiling ONNX models into optimized engines for each accelerator, the Space Inference Engine and its execution providers, the SDK that packages models for flight, and the perf tooling that proves a model fits its power, thermal, and latency budget before it ever leaves the ground. As we open the platform to a growing roster of defense and Earth-observation partners, the team's scope and the range of silicon we target are expanding fast.

As our ML Runtime Engineer, you'll own model compilation and the performance tooling behind it. We're looking for someone scrappy - the kind of engineer who takes an unfamiliar model and an unforgiving power budget, digs into the graph, and gets it running on real hardware without waiting for the path to be handed to them. You'll move between model compilation, runtime internals, quantization, and hardware-in-the-loop CI, sometimes in the same afternoon.

 *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

Who We Are

Loft: Space Made Simple. 

Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

- Drive hardware R&D: Identify R&D opportunities for control and automation hardware. Act as an expert customer to specify and co-design with external vendors.

- Exceptional execution & delivery leadership: Proven experience as a delivery or execution lead, selecting outstanding talent and building highly collaborative teams in a fast-moving environment. You excel at translating complex R&D into operational reality.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70% weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Outbound-Anteil (Kaltakquise, Walk-ins, eigene Terminierung).

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen..

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Head of Security Engineering
description:
About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role
DriveWealth LLC is seeking a highly motivated and seasoned Head of Security Engineering to own the
security engineering strategy, roadmap, and delivery across our product platform and corporate environment.
Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, you will build and lead the Security Engineering team,
define its strategy and roadmap, and deliver improvements that support the security of customer data, the
firm’s growth, and regulatory obligations.
In this leadership role, you will provide both expert guidance on security and security capability
implementation across our AWS platform, Kubernetes services, low-latency trading infrastructure, and
corporate technology. This role is focused on building and maturing the Security Engineering function and we
are seeking a leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on engineering experience to establish
scalable controls and enable product innovation. You will also lead the development and maintenance of
infrastructure, services, and automation for Security Operations, partnering with Engineering, IT, Risk, and
Compliance within an innovative and entrepreneurial culture.
What You’ll Do
What You’ll Do
Strategy & Team Leadership

•
Roadmap Ownership: Define and deliver a multiyear security engineering strategy and quarterly roadmap across product and corporate environments, aligning architecture standards and investments with business priorities and risk appetite.

•
Team Leadership: Hire, coach, and develop a team of high-performing security engineers, manage performance, and build technical depth as the team scales.

•
Delivery & Risk Management: Manage backlogs, budgets, vendors, and dependencies. Work with Security GRC to measure control effectiveness and delivery. Communicate progress, tradeoffs, and residual risks to the CISO and technology leaders.

Product & Corporate Security

•
Product Security: Embed threat modeling, architecture reviews, security testing, and secure design into development and CI/CD, strengthening API authentication, authorization, data isolation, and secrets management.

•
Infrastructure Security: Secure AWS, including services such as EKS, EC2, DynamoDB, as well as co-located trading infrastructure through least privilege, segmentation, encryption, hardening, and automated guardrails, accounting for availability, recovery, and latency requirements.

•
Corporate Security: Partner with IT to mature identity, access governance, endpoint, remote access, DLP, communications, and SaaS security across the corporate service estate, including phishing-resistant authentication, device compliance, and data protection.

title: AI Product Engineer - ClickStack
description:
Join us in building the AI layer for Observability!

ClickStack is the open-source observability platform we're building at ClickHouse - logs, metrics, traces, and session replays unified so engineers can find root causes quickly. The interesting work now is in the agent layer: systems that can investigate an incident at 2 AM, propose a root cause, and hand the on-call a concise summary by the time they've logged in.

We're hiring an AI Product Engineer to build agentic capabilities on top of a petabyte-scale observability platform, with a focus on developer experience. If you've been building agents, designing skills, and wiring up MCP servers - and you've hit the limits of generic copilots for production work - we'd like to talk.

What you'll do

- Build agents that investigate incidents. They surface anomalies, answer "why is production broken?", and use ClickStack as their substrate.

- Write skills, not just prompts. Build a library of reusable skills that captures how our team debugs, finds root causes, writes ClickHouse queries, and runs incident response, so agents pick up the right playbook instead of starting from scratch.

- Own the agent stack end-to-end. Context engineering, tool design, evals, tracing, cost. You're responsible for whether the agent works in production.

- Work in the open. Collaborate with OSS contributors and customers, debug their problems alongside them, and feed what you learn back into the product.

- Tackle the hard parts. Latency, cost, context window limits, eval coverage, hallucinations on real telemetry.

Who you are

- You've been building agents long enough to have opinions - about context engineering, tool design, when to use a skill vs. a tool, what evals catch and miss, and where popular frameworks break down.

- You move quickly, ship often, and learn from what breaks.

- You care about developer tools and have a clear sense of what good DX looks like.

- You do well with ambiguity and ownership.

What you bring

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 1-2 years on LLM-powered systems or agents in production.

- Strong backend skills in TypeScript/Node.js and/or Python. Comfortable in both, even if one is primary.

- Hands-on experience building agents: multi-step tool use, planning, memory, error recovery. You've shipped them and dealt with the failure modes.

- Experience designing skills (Markdown-based workflow encodings, Anthropic-style or similar) and a clear view on when a skill, a tool, or both is the right fit.

- Experience with MCP: building servers, designing tools, and thinking through auth, scoping, and observability for agentic systems.

- Strong evals practice: golden sets, LLM-as-judge, regression detection.

- SQL proficiency - you can write ClickHouse queries directly.

- Comfort with Docker and Kubernetes.

- Active in open source and the developer community.

Bonus

- Built or operated production agents in observability, incident response, or SRE.

- Strong opinions on agent observability - tracing, cost attribution, eval pipelines, OpenTelemetry for agents - and ideas on how to improve it.

- Experience with prompt caching, context compaction, or other techniques relevant to running agents on production telemetry volumes.

- Experience with columnar databases and event ingestion pipelines.

- Contributed to or maintained an open source AI/agent project.

- Familiarity with Go, Rust, or other systems languages for integrations and high-throughput infra.

Diese Forschung wird dazu beitragen, sichere, angenehme und effektive Einsatzmöglichkeiten für Robotik in Gesundheitsumgebungen zu definieren.

WIE ES FUNKTIONIERT

Sie nehmen an einem Remote-Interview teil, um uns durch Ihre typischen Pflegeroutinen zu führen. Wir werden Sie bitten zu beschreiben, welche Rolle physischer Kontakt bei Ihren täglichen Interaktionen mit Patientinnen und Patienten spielt. Sie werden außerdem konzeptionelle Szenarien mit Assistenzrobotern in Pflegeumgebungen prüfen und darauf reagieren. Schließlich geben Sie Feedback dazu, wo robotergestützte Assistenz sinnvoll ist und wo menschliche Berührung unersetzlich bleibt.

FÜR WEN DIES GEDACHT IST

Wir freuen uns über aktive Pflegefachkräfte, professionelle Betreuungskräfte und Pflegeassistenten mit praktischer Patientenerfahrung. Fachkräfte, die in Krankenhäusern, Langzeitpflegeeinrichtungen oder in der häuslichen Krankenpflege tätig sind, werden ausdrücklich ermutigt, sich zu bewerben. Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis der täglichen physischen Patientenversorgung und der Abläufe am Krankenbett ist für die Teilnahme erforderlich.

WAS SIE TUN WERDEN

- Beschreiben Sie Ihre tägliche Routine und physische Interaktionen mit Patientinnen und Patienten

- Bewerten Sie konzeptionelle Szenarien für die Mensch-Roboter-Interaktion in der Pflege

- Geben Sie Feedback zu den emotionalen und praktischen Aspekten sozialer Berührung

- Diskutieren Sie die Grenzen zwischen menschlicher Pflege und automatisierter Assistenz

WER SICH BEWERBEN SOLLTE

- Aktive Fachkraft in der Kranken- oder Altenpflege

- Direkte Erfahrung mit praktischer Patientenversorgung und täglicher physischer Unterstützung

title: AWS Cloud Engineer

Position Summary
The AWS Cloud Engineer - IL6 / Backend & Database is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, securing, and maintaining cloud-based solutions within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Impact Level 6 (IL6) environments supporting mission-critical government and Department of Defense (DoD) programs.

The position combines advanced AWS cloud engineering, backend application development, and database engineering responsibilities. The engineer will develop and integrate backend services, APIs, data services, and database solutions while ensuring that infrastructure and applications meet stringent security, performance, scalability, availability, and compliance requirements.
This position is 100% remote.

Salary Range: 130k+

Key Responsibilities

• Design, deploy, configure, and maintain secure AWS infrastructure within IL6 environments.

• Develop, integrate, and maintain backend applications, microservices, APIs, and data services supporting mission-critical systems.

• Design and implement scalable, highly available database architectures within AWS.

• Develop and optimize relational databases, including schema design, indexing, queries, stored procedures, transactions, and performance tuning.

• Work with technologies such as Amazon RDS, Aurora, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, DynamoDB, and other AWS database services as appropriate.

• Design and implement data models and database schemas that support application and mission requirements.

• Develop cloud-native applications using serverless, containerized, and microservices architectures where appropriate.

• Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or similar technologies.

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting automated application, infrastructure, and database deployments.

• Implement and maintain AWS security controls consistent with DoD, DISA, FedRAMP, NIST, and RMF requirements.

• Configure and manage AWS IAM, encryption, secrets management, security groups, logging, monitoring, and other security capabilities.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and administering AWS cloud environments.

• Demonstrated experience working in AWS IL6, AWS GovCloud, or comparable high-security government cloud environments.

• Experience with one or more enterprise database platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or Amazon Aurora.

• Experience with AWS database services such as RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, or similar technologies.

• Experience designing database schemas, data models, relationships, and data-access layers.

• Experience developing REST APIs, microservices, or other backend services.

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform and/or CloudFormation.

• Experience with CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.

• Experience implementing security controls within regulated AWS environments.

• Understanding of NIST 800-53, RMF, FedRAMP, DISA STIGs, and DoD cybersecurity requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with AWS GovCloud and IL6 environments.

• Experience with PostgreSQL/Aurora PostgreSQL in large-scale production environments.

• Experience with DynamoDB or other NoSQL databases.

• Experience with database replication, clustering, partitioning, and high-availability architectures.

Ciroos is hiring a Technical Customer Success / Customer Program Manager to own the customer program from onboarding through adoption - connecting the dots across the customer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Product, and Engineering. This is a role for someone who knows how to drive: you'll know what needs to happen, who owns it, what's blocked, what needs to be prioritized, and what comes next to keep the customer moving forward. You'll be the person making sure things don't fall through the cracks.
You need enough technical depth to be comfortable working with SRE, observability, cloud, infrastructure, integrations, and enterprise IT teams - but you are not expected to be the FDE building everything yourself. Your job is to make the entire program move.
What You'll Do
Program Ownership & Cross-Functional Orchestration

• Own the customer program end-to-end from onboarding through adoption, tracking what needs to happen, who owns it, what's blocked, and what to prioritize next.

• Drive accountability across teams: when Engineering owes something, you drive it to closure; when Product needs to make a decision, you get it in front of them; when priorities compete, you help create clarity.

• Coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder technical deliverables to a clean finish - for example, driving an enterprise security questionnaire (such as a Splunk-integration review covering data retention, permissions, token encryption, and incident response) from a draft with open “pending engineering confirmation” items to a fully-owned, sign-off-ready response, assigning clear owners and chasing each item to closure.

• Make sure Ciroos is delivering measurable value against what the customer actually cares about, not just what was scoped at kickoff.

Technical Fluency & Escalation Support

• Partner with FDE and Engineering on technical questions, security/compliance reviews, and integration asks that surface mid-program, translating between customer language and internal owners in both directions.

title: Pricing and Monetization Manager
description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

THE ROLE

Mercor produces all sorts of data of data types, for AI labs and enterprise customers. We're hiring someone to own pricing structures across our data types.

This person will build the pricing models, rate cards, and margin frameworks to ensure pricing is consistent and defensible.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Acquisition pricing & cost modeling (buy side)

- Establish fair market value for the data we buy - by data type, domain, and end buyer - and set the acquisition cost ceilings that bound what we'll pay

- Track competitor bidding behavior and maintain the cost curves that tell us when to pay up to win a corpus and when to walk

- Model fully-loaded cost to serve: acquisition price, extraction, human QC, anonymization/PII, and LLM inference - not just what we pay the vendor

- Define the priceable unit for each data type - per repo, per file, per video minute, per audio hour - and the quality attributes that move price within a unit

Monetization & margin strategy (sell side)

- Design pricing and packaging frameworks for data by data type, volume, format, and customer segment

- Build rate cards and tiered pricing for recurring, repeatable data products

- Own unit economics per deal and per data product, including transfer pricing, internal chargeback, and direct vs. indirect revenue attribution across account P&Ls

- Build the pricing/forecasting toolkit Finance and leadership use to evaluate new data products before launch

- Continuously test and refine pricing using win/loss data, renewal behavior, and market feedback

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 6+ years in pricing strategy, monetization, revenue operations, or a related analytical/strategy role - ideally at a data, marketplace, or B2B SaaS company

- Strong financial/quantitative modeling skills - fluent in Excel/Sheets; SQL a strong plus

- Track record of building pricing models from scratch, not just tuning ones already in place

- Comfortable operating with real ambiguity - public benchmarks for pricing data assets are thin, so structured judgment matters as much as data

- Sharp cross-functional communicator - this person works daily with Sourcing, Sales, Finance, and Product

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience pricing a two-sided marketplace (a cost/supply side and a demand/sell side), not just a single-sided product

- Background in AI training data, or market data

BENEFITS

- Bi-annual performance bonus structure

- Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

- Up to $15k Relocation bonus

- $10K proximity bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

- $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

- Free Equinox membership

- $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

- $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

- Health, Dental, Vision insurance

At Hone Health , we believe the next generation of healthcare won't be defined by treating disease. It will be defined by proactively helping people live longer, perform better, and remain healthy for decades. We are excited to be launching a new concierge practice, Hone Black , to build that future, combining exceptional physicians, comprehensive diagnostics, technology, and concierge service into an entirely new model of longitudinal care.
Our members aren't looking for another annual physical or a collection of diagnostic tests. They want a trusted physician-led team to proactively oversee their health, identify risk early, optimize performance, and help them navigate an increasingly complex healthcare system over many years. Our patients are highly engaged members who are invested in their health and eager to partner with their physician over the long term. They value prevention over reaction, data over guesswork, and personalized care over one-size-fits-all medicine.
We're looking for a Founding Physician of Hone Black who wants more than a traditional clinical role. This physician will provide exceptional, longitudinal care to a select panel of concierge members while also helping build the clinical backbone of the practice. • Partner with members over time, proactively optimizing health, performance, and longevity through ongoing follow-up and monitoring

• Translate complex medical concepts into practical, actionable r

About CWS

CWS builds and runs the security and cloud infrastructure companies depend on. We design, deploy, tune and operate production platforms across Montreal, QC, Canada : SIEM onboarding and detection engineering, cloud identity and access, edge and firewall platforms, security programs, data protection, and secure cloud environments built as code. We do not hand off at go-live. We run the managed service on top of what we build, so the systems we deploy stay tuned and defensible.

We work through technology partners and directly with customers. Every engineer here works directly with the founders and owns a real customer outcome from day one.

Role & Responsibilities

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own the customer engagement end to end: you scope the work, architect the solution, build and configure it, prove it holds up, and hand over a system the customer's team can run without you. You are both the engineer and the person accountable for the result.

You carry one to three engagements at a time, spanning cloud and infrastructure delivery (AWS, Google Cloud, infrastructure as code, networking, edge and firewall platforms) and security delivery (tool implementation, tuning, and assessments).

• Deploy, configure and integrate security and cloud platforms in customer environments, and prove they work before you hand them over.

• Plan and run your engagements: milestones, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and a weekly status the customer can read in two minutes.

• Raise risks early, and bring options and a recommendation with them.

• Write the as-built documentation and runbooks, run the knowledge transfer, and train the customer's team so they can operate without you.

• Contribute to managed-service work on platforms we run: health checks, tuning, and renewal assessments.

• Help scope new work: effort estimates, technical input to statements of work, and kickoff material.

• After each engagement, write down what changed between the plan and what it took, and turn it into an asset the team reuses.

Qualifications

• Three to five years in security engineering, DevSecOps or platform engineering, or software engineering, including at least one year delivering into environments you did not own.

• Hands-on AWS, and working knowledge of Azure or Google Cloud: identity, networking, compute, storage, logging.

• Networking you can troubleshoot: DNS, routing, VPN, firewalls, load balancing, TLS.

• Infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) and version control as daily habits.

• Python or TypeScript at a level where you build your own tooling.

• Security fundamentals across identity, endpoint, network and cloud posture, and the ability to explain a finding to a non-technical owner.

• Clear written and spoken English. You write your own status updates, as-builts and runbooks.

• Delivery experience in a consulting, professional services or managed security firm, where you owned a schedule and a customer relationship.

• French, spoken and written. Part of our delivery is in French.

• Compliance context: SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS.

title: Sale Operations Manager
description:
Sales Operations Manager
Dili
Team: Revenue Operations
Reports to: CEO
Location: NYC
Type: Full-time
About the role
Dili helps build software and AI for energy developers, construction firms and project owners. Our customers are sophisticated and their procurement processes are rigorous; which means the path from “great demo” to “signed contract” runs through security questionnaires, vendor onboarding portals, redlines, and pricing approvals.
This role owns that path. You will sit between our sales team and our compliance team, translating in both directions: pulling the compliance detail our prospects’ diligence teams demand, and making sure what sales commits to is something we can actually deliver and bill for. It’s the connective tissue role, the person who makes deals close cleanly instead of stalling in someone’s legal inbox.
This is a strong fit for someone who likes owning process end to end, is comfortable being the person everyone routes things through, and gets satisfaction from turning a chaotic close into a repeatable one.
What you’ll own
Vendor questionnaires and diligence. Own the intake and response process for security, procurement, and vendor onboarding questionnaires. Build and maintain a reusable answer library, pull in compliance and engineering only where genuinely needed, and drive each one to completion rather than letting it sit.
Proposals. Prepare and assemble customer-facing proposals and RFP responses - scoping, pricing, compliance narrative, and supporting materials. Maintain a library of reusable content so each proposal starts from proven language rather than a blank page, and manage submission deadlines and formatting requirements.
Order forms and pricing. Generate order forms, quotes, and renewals. Enforce the pricing and discount approval structure, flag non-standard terms early, and keep pricing documentation current as packaging evolves.
Contracts. Manage the contract lifecycle from first draft through signature and countersignature - MSAs, order forms, NDAs, DPAs, and vendor agreements. Track redlines, run the internal review loop with legal and compliance, maintain the executed-contract repository, and own the renewal and expiration calendar.
Accounting coordination. Hand off closed-won deals cleanly to accounting: billing terms, invoicing triggers, payment schedules, revenue recognition inputs. Serve as the point of contact for billing questions and help resolve collections issues before they escalate.
HubSpot management. Own HubSpot as the system of record - pipeline hygiene, deal stages, properties, workflows, quote templates, and reporting. Build the dashboards leadership uses to run forecast and pipeline reviews, and keep the data clean enough to trust.
Sales support and scheduling. Coordinate meetings and demos, prepare materials, track follow-ups, and handle the operational load that otherwise pulls reps out of selling time.
What we’re looking for

• 3+ years in sales operations, contract administration, revenue operations, or a similar role at a B2B software or services company

• Hands-on HubSpot experience (or comparable CRM, with willingness to go deep on HubSpot)

• Direct experience managing contracts and order forms through a full lifecycle, including working alongside legal on redlines

• Proposal or RFP response experience, with the writing ability to produce client-ready documents without heavy editing

• Comfort with security and vendor questionnaires - you’ve completed them, not just forwarded them

• Strong written communication and the judgment to know when to decide and when to escalate

• Genuine organizational discipline: nothing gets dropped, and status is always knowable without being asked

Nice to have

• Exposure to renewable energy, construction, or regulatory compliance environments

• Familiarity with prevailing wage or Davis-Bacon concepts (we will teach this - no need to arrive with it)

• Experience selling into enterprise procurement or public sector buy
